title: An exactly solvable evaporation-deposition PCA with long-distance interactions
summary: We consider a probabilistic cellular automaton (PCA) of evaporation-deposition on the one-dimensional lattice having $n$ sites with periodic boundary conditions, in which each site, during each epoch, can be in one of two states: $0$ and $1$. Fix a positive integer $m\geqslant 2$. There are two types of transitions at each discrete time, which are as follows: (i) the first site in every contiguous block of $m$ $0$s becomes a $1$ with probability $p_1$, and (ii) the first site in every contiguous block of $(m-1)$ $0$s followed immediately by a $1$ also becomes a $1$ with probability…
